request.description: Fresh clean pixel-art BASE DESIGN for SPRIG, a compact adult-proportioned gardening ROBOT caretaker of an enchanted moonlit garden. Use the original drawing for identity. Crucially preserve its MAILBOX-SHAPED HEAD: a sturdy rounded-top postal-box housing with a flat front face/slot, mechanical features and the recognizable @ emblem where appropriate. This is a robot, not a human in a helmet. Keep articulated mechanical claws and a solid readable robot body. Add a SMALL PRACTICAL GARDENING TOOL KIT: one claw holds a short hand trowel, a compact two-prong hand cultivator is clipped neatly at the hip, and a small watering-can attachment/tank is mounted at the opposite hip or back. Make these tools simple bold recognizable shapes, not a cluttered arsenal. No weapons or guns. Calm ready standing pose, facing slightly left; expressive mechanical personality without baby/chibi proportions. Muted moss-green enamel and weathered blue-gray metal with restrained warm brass accents; a few broad flat shades per material. Match finished game art's thick dark outlines, coherent clean pixel clusters and simple adult silhouettes. No tiny rivet texture, dirty shading, white/light-gray speckles, gradients, dithering or excess highlights. Entire mailbox head, claws, tools and feet inside a transparent 192x192 square with generous animation margins. No scene, text labels or effects.

reference_images.usage: Original Sprig / E-Mailson robot identity: mailbox-shaped head, @ emblem and mechanical claws. Keep this identity; redesign cleanly rather than copying sketch rendering.
Final game outline weight, flat shading and clean broad pixel clusters only. Do not copy species or props.
